title: A live-logs miss at the verdict door names its cause
intention: When the verdict door's re-run of an instrument cannot find a file under the live logs tree, its refusal names that cause, so the builder is not left with a bare traceback. In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py: a helper _seal_absence(run) matches a tail line with FileNotFoundError or 'No such file or directory' naming a path under /.cairn/logs. It returns a cause line naming that path, the sealed exec's empty logs tree (68cef2ddd8ef) and the remedy. The reports-pass contradiction line appends it after the output tail. Other refusals are unchanged.
why: Law 7: errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces. The verdict refusal is the diagnostic surface for a PROVED crossing. Measured by BUILDER 2026-10-13 sailing ea4a6151300f: an instrument reading domain.tickets_dir() raised FileNotFoundError at the door and passed by hand, and the refusal never said why. Measured 2026-10-18 by CC: inside bin/cairn test --exec, ls ~/.cairn/logs prints nothing.

No such file or directory: <path under /.cairn/logs>' is refused with 'live logs tree' and that path in the refusal. (2) A disagreement whose tail names no such path carries no 'live logs tree' line. (3) A FileNotFoundError on a path outside the logs tree carries none either. Measured 2026-10-18: tooth 1 red against today's verdict.py, all three green with the change. decisions.text:
D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Questions a Haiku builder would need, answered. (a) The one file that changes is cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py: _LIVE_LOGS_MISSING_RE and _seal_absence(run) sit just above _declared, and the reports-pass contradiction line in _observed_entries appends _seal_absence(o['run']) after the tail. (b) The exact change is this unified diff, applied verbatim with git apply:
diff --git a/cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py b/cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py
index 58dd2f24..6181699b 100644
--- a/cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py
+++ b/cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py
@@ -265,6 +265,25 @@ def run_instrument(command: str, *, timeout_s: int = _TIMEOUT_DEFAULT,
     return record
 
 
+# THE SEAL'S EMPTY LOGS TREE, NAMED (ticket 87ea3fb1058c). The sealed exec an instrument
+# re-runs in leaves ~/.cairn/logs empty by design, so an instrument that reads live logs fails
+# here and passes when run by hand, and its refusal was a bare traceback. A tail that cannot
+# find a file under that tree is a cause the builder can act on, so the refusal says it.
+_LIVE_LOGS_MISSING_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:FileNotFoundError|No such file or directory)[^\n]*?(/[^\s'\"]*/\.cairn/logs\b[^\s'\":]*)")
+
+
+def _seal_absence(run: dict) -> str:
+    """The sentence naming why a re-run failed inside the seal, or "" when its tail names none."""
+    found = _LIVE_LOGS_MISSING_RE.search(run.get("tail") or "")
+    if not found:
+        return ""
+    return ("\n    --- cause ---\n    the instrument reads %s, under the live logs tree, which "
+            "the verdict's sealed exec leaves empty by design (68cef2ddd8ef); point the "
+            "criterion at state that exists inside the seal, such as the proof's own teeth "
+            "or a sealed validation" % found.group(1))
+
+
 def _declared(criterion, entry, field, default):
     """WHAT A PASS LOOKS LIKE, read from the chart first and the verdict second.
 
@@ -371,9 +390,9 @@ def _observed_entries(observations) -> list:
             contradicted_claims.append(o["claim"])
             contradicted_lines.append(
                 "%r reports pass, but %r exited %r where the claim holding means %r"
-                "\n    --- output tail ---\n%s"
+                "\n    --- output tail ---\n%s%s"
                 % (o["claim"], o["run"]["command"], o["run"].get("exit"),
-                   o["expect_exit"], o["run"].get("tail")))
+                   o["expect_exit"], o["run"].get("tail"), _seal_absence(o["run"])))
         elif o["outcome"] == "fail" and agrees:
